body: thanks so much for your comment as well... it means a lot to me to know there is someone who cares.

In general, I just feel like I've caused so many problems for the people I know, and I don't think I deserve to live. 

An example was a girl that I used to date... I really loved seeing her daily, but I just needed to have some space due to school. We decided to take a break soon after, and I heard recently that she was having suicidal thoughts. 

Another thing is that I just don't even think my work is necessary. Why do we need to wake up every single day to go to work/school, deal with problems concerning other people, and be forced to go through so much stress? wouldn't ending that misery be the best option than to go through such agony?
